faqs.answer: Phoenix 8 features several luxury amenities including: indoor and outdoor pools, kiddie pool, sauna, hot tubs, fitness center, tennis court, pickleball court, basketball, covered parking, EV chargers, and barbeque grills.

faqs.question: What popular attractions are close to Phoenix VIII?
faqs.answer: In the heart of Orange Beach, Phoenix VIII condos boast direct beach access and close proximity to endless shops, restaurants, and entertainment. Grab a bite at The Gulf or Cobalt, listen to live music at the world-famous Flora-Bama beach bar, or head out on the water with a fishing charter or dolphin cruise. Nearby Gulf State Park is a great place for fishing, hiking, and bike trails, The Wharf features tons of entertainment, and several arcades and amusement parks are just a short drive away.

faqs.question: What are the check-in and check-out times at Phoenix 8?
faqs.answer: Check-in and check-out times vary by season. For more information, refer to our Check In and Check Out Times Pageand review your booking confirmation message.

faqs.question: Do all Phoenix 8 condominiums have Gulf views?
faqs.answer: Yes, all Phoenix 8 vacation rentals have Gulf views that you’ll enjoy from private balconies or through floor-to-ceiling windows.

faqs.question: Is there beach access available at Phoenix VIII?
faqs.answer: Yes, Phoenix VIII has direct beach access and offers beach chair rentals for guests.

faqs.question: Is there a grocery store nearby Phoenix 8 where guests can purchase food, supplies and necessities?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are several grocery stores located near Phoenix 8 in Orange Beach, including Publix, Walmart, and Winn-Dixie. Grocery delivery is offered at participating stores with partnering apps.

faqs.question: Does Phoenix VIII have accessibility options?
faqs.answer: : Phoenix VIII Orange Beach is equipped with accessibility features to ensure that guests can enjoy their stay. The resort has accessible entrances and public areas, including ramps and elevators. The units were also originally designed with accessibility in mind. Contact us at 1-800-211-7892 to discuss accommodations and options.

faqs.question: Is Phoenix 8 a good choice for family vacations?
faqs.answer: Yes, Phoenix 8 Orange Beach is very family-friendly. The luxury condos sleep up to 10 guests with fully-furnished rooms, well-equipped kitchens, and spacious layouts. Phoenix 8 also has tons of family-friendly amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, a kiddie pool, tennis courts, basketball, and more. It’s easy to walk to restaurants, shops, and marinas, and grocery stores and endless entertainment are just a short drive away. Family fun awaits at Phoenix 8 Orange Beach!

faqs.question: Is there a washer and dryer in each unit at Phoenix VIII?
faqs.answer: Yes, each unit at Phoenix VIII is equipped with a washer and dryer.

faqs.question: Is there free Wi-Fi available at Phoenix 8?
faqs.answer: Yes, Phoenix 8 offers complimentary Wi-Fi access for guests.

faqs.question: Why book a Phoenix VIII rental with Brett/Robinson?
faqs.answer: By booking with Brett/Robinson Vacations you get the benefit of over 40 years of experience in the area. Brett/Robinson operates and maintains Phoenix VIII and we have an on-site staff available to ensure you have a superb stay at the beach. We focus on quality, cleanliness and functionality in all of our available units. Our dedicated on-site customer service staff is here to help with any needs you have during your stay.
